note: Cups for the AIS haptic-search robot demo (helperFunction/haptic_robot_frame.py). tcp_offset: UR set_tcp [m, rad], cup lip on the cup axis. chamber_map[i] = sensor channel of simulator chamber i; body_offset_deg = simulator body yaw minus tool yaw (seen from above). Old ROS1 hints (not trusted): 3ch pressure order [1, 2, 0]; yaw = -tool_yaw - 90 deg. lip_radius_mm: sealing-lip radius (simulator 5 mm); measure on the real cup.
